verses.ilahiya-anta-l-khaliqu-l-bari-u-l-ladhi-: ʾilahiyā ʾanta l-khāliqu l-bāriʾu lladhī ghaniyyu ʿani l-ʾadhkāri waṣ-ṣalawāti
fajahlu l-warā bid-dīni ghayyarahu ʾadhā wajahlu l-warā bil-ḥukmi sharru ḥayāti
walam ʾara shayʾā kāna ʾawlā biḥurmahi mina l-wālidayni maʿdinay ḥurumāti
walam ʾara maʿrūfā ʾabarra likullinā wala sharafā ʾasmā mina n-nafaqāti
wamā fataḥa l-ʾaqṭāra ʾila jamāʿatu lahā thiqahu bil-ʿidli wal-ḥasanāti
ʿalā raʾasihā khayru l-barāyā muḥammadu waṣāḥibuhu fī ṣ-ṣidqi waṣ-ṣadaqāti
waʿuthmānu wal-fārūqu wal-ḥaydaru lladhī yumaththilu fīhim ʾaḥkama l-ʿibarāti
